title: SetPetStatePayload
description: Shape of the payload carried on the pet:setState channel, for pet/contracts/rive-state-machine@1.0.0. It is the only way the application changes what the pet is doing, and it carries a state rather than an animation, so the asset keeps ownership of how one state becomes another. A value outside the declared set is dropped and the current state is held, which is why the range is expressed here rather than left to the renderer.

state.description: 0 idle, 1 receiving an order, 2 working, 3 waiting for an approval, 4 holding a result. The mapping is fixed: changing which number means which state is a MAJOR change, because an asset produced against the old mapping would animate the wrong thing rather than fail.
